metadata.description: Track A/B correlation analysis to assess DualTrack complementarity
metadata.track_a_definition: C1 (path selection) + C2 (mandatory completion) — 'did you do the right things?'
metadata.track_b_definition: C4 (timing) + C5 (sequence) — 'did you do them correctly?'

track_a_vs_track_b.interpretation: Track A and Track B are COMPLEMENTARY (low correlation) — DualTrack measures distinct constructs.

C1_path_selection_vs_C4_timing.interpretation: C1 and C4 measure independent sub-constructs (low correlation).

conclusion: DualTrack is validated as complementary: Track A (what to do) and Track B (how to do it) are not redundant sub-measures.
